### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **26** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `93460db3b8e889cbfd9f862493460443a419464d` — the merge of head `7b14b3d3e51972083c03022a2be241857c3ad280` into base `0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 93460db3b8e889cbfd9f862493460443a419464d && git checkout 93460db3b8e889cbfd9f862493460443a419464d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e 7b14b3d3e51972083c03022a2be241857c3ad280 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e && git merge --no-ff 7b14b3d3e51972083c03022a2be241857c3ad280

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0561a988cb0b8b73becf80bbac8b3a407ed16e7e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f0e6671a19bed0a008f4cafd04a033f93708c1f7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-search-empty-set.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/query-expression-conformance.test.ts, packages/rest/src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts, packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/rest/src/data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/empty-projection-door.ts, packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts, packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts, ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useServerGrouping.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts, ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.ts, skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md (prose faces judged in ② and ④: .changeset/27484-blank-search-fields-refused.md, content/docs/api/data-api.mdx, content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx)

Reviewed-at: 2026-10-29T17:45Z

Inputs: card #27484 (body and all 8 comments, among them triage 6496252317, retriage 6497944037 / 6498776875 / 6499611991, ruling 6500648325, claim 6499488942, os-dev-reports 6499580381 and 6503706236), PR #27670 body and file list (9 files, +286/−20), the net diff `origin/main...pr27670` (merge-base b761968d, local ref equals the head), the 50 check-runs on the head: 37 `success`, 13 `skipped` (path-filtered UI and opt-in lanes), none failed or in progress. Of the ten required contexts, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Test UI` are `success`; `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` are `skipped` on a diff with no `ui/` path. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was built, run or re-run here (every file cited below was read with `git show pr27670:PATH`).

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept-set narrowing at `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#findData` — right.** `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` (`protocol-query-validation.ts` L839–L900) now throws `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `param` = the caller's spelling when the normalised list is empty: blank or comma-only string, `[]`, `$searchFields` of the same, and object-form `search.fields` `[]` / `''`. The shape check precedes `resolveQueryFields`, so a registry-less host refuses too. The alias fold (`protocol.ts` L12982–L12989) copies a blank value (`'' != null`) and records `$searchFields` as the wire spelling, which is what the pins assert. Every HTTP door read here reaches that one gate: `GET /data/:object` hands `req.query` straight to `findData` (`crud-routes.ts` L157–L163); `POST /data/:object/query` parses the body against `FindDataRequestSchema` and then calls `findData` (L357–L377); `GET /data/:object/export` forwards `searchFields` only beside `search` (`data-action-routes.ts` L1355). The list's `total` count (L13570) and the aggregate branch (L13424) receive `options.searchFields` after the gate, so one refusal covers them.
2. **A second narrowing the PR body and changeset do not spell out — right in behaviour, under-declared.** The gate is called "whether or not a `search` term rode along" (`protocol.ts` L13184–L13199), so `GET /data/x?$searchFields=` with no `$search` is now 400 where it was 200 (before: `names = []`, `return`, the engine then ignored the option). The posture is the axis's own — the existing pin "the override is validated even without a search term riding along" (`query-expression-conformance.test.ts` L2237–L2246) already refuses a stale non-empty override without a term — so the empty case inherits it consistently. The changeset's Before/Now describe only the "beside a search" case. Should-fix S1 (prose).
3. **Export route — right.** `typeof q.searchFields === 'string'` now yields `[]` for a blank value; the `length === 0 → undefined` drop is gone; the array arm is unchanged; the route forwards `searchFields` only when `search` is set (L1355, and `[]` is truthy), so "ignored without `search`" still holds as the route's docblock declares (L958). `DATA_EXPORT_PARAMS` (`rest-server.ts` L675) is a recognition set, untouched; the multiplicity census deliberately leaves `searchFields` multi-valued (`query-multiplicity.ts` L52) — both unaffected.
4. **Public surface — unchanged at the package boundary; right.** `quotedQueryValue` becomes a module export of `protocol.ts`; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts` re-exports by name (L3, L7, L17, L122, L134, L217) and carries no `export *`, so no new symbol leaves `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. The changeset's "no export or type changes" holds at the boundary a consumer sees.
5. **Engine posture unchanged — right as ruled, an asymmetry worth naming.** `engine.find` / `count` / `aggregate` with `searchFields: []` or `''` still fall back to the allowed set (`spec/data/search-fields.ts` `resolveSearchFields` L265–L274; the engine reads `ast.searchFields ?? raw.fields` at `engine.ts` L13380). Ruling 6500648325 keeps it so and the changeset's "Unchanged" bullet and `queries.mdx` L555–L556 say so. On the projection axis the engine was later taught to refuse `fields: []` itself (#27008, `objectql/src/empty-projection-door.ts`), so a hook, flow or plugin that builds an empty `searchFields` list by mistake still widens silently at the engine while an empty `fields` list does not. Escalated in ③, not a defect of this diff.
6. **The published declaration is not narrowed with the door — wrong as an end state, acceptable as a stage.** `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields` is `z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())])` (`data-engine.zod.ts` L962), `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.searchFields` is `z.array(z.string())` (L189), `QuerySchema.searchFields` the same (`query.zod.ts` L549) and `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` likewise (L452): all admit `''` and `[]`. The sibling `$select` / `select` / `fields` carry `PROJECTION_ACCEPT_SET` (#26909, L110–L141, L953, L974), with the spec pin "§6 the projection spellings admit exactly what the doors accept" (`query-transport.test.ts` L404). So on `main` the spec does not refuse an empty `searchFields`; this narrowing takes a declared capability away at the consumer rather than making the spec's own refusal real. The tree shows the consequence: on `POST /data/:object/query`, `select: []` is the schema door's `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (`data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts` L166–L175), while `searchFields: []` passes `FindDataRequestSchema.safeParse` and is the gate's `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (new door test L369–L378) — two sibling axes, one shape class, different codes on one door. The projection axis itself landed door-first (#26644), then the declaration (#26909), then the engine (#27008), so a door-first stage is the repo's own precedent and not a FAIL; what it owes is the declaration in the changeset and the follow-up card. Should-fix S2.
7. **Error code and envelope (brief point 3) — right.** `VALIDATION_ERROR` is the standard vocabulary's generic 400 member (`spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts` L55; `400: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'` L184), ADR-0112's closed set. The thrown object — `status 400`, `code`, `param`, message `Query parameter 'PARAM' names no field; got VALUE. The query was not run: …` — is the `projectionFieldsValue` shape line for line (`protocol.ts` L4669–L4684), and both are rendered by the same `mapDataError` (`types/src/data-error-classification.ts` L654), which puts `code` and `error` on the wire and `param` on neither. Same envelope, same words, one new sentence.
8. **In-repo producers (brief point 2) — none breaks; right.** Every Console producer sends `$searchFields` / `searchFields` only when the list has at least one entry: the data-source adapter guards all three request paths (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` L5133, L5250, L5385), and above it `plugin-list/ListView.tsx` L3447 / L5169 / L6536, `plugin-grid/objectGridRowLoad.ts` L575, `useServerGrouping.ts` L199 / L219, `useWholeSetSummary.ts` L163, `plugin-kanban/ObjectKanban.tsx` L700, `plugin-gantt/ObjectGantt.tsx` L876, `fields/useRecordQuery.ts` L215; `ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts` refuses `$searchFields` before any request. `packages/client/src`, `packages/client-react/src`, `examples/`, `packages/mcp/src` and `skills/` hold no `searchFields` producer at all (0 files each on `pr27670`); `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` L319 teaches "Omit it". No test outside the three in-PR files pins the ABSENT posture (0 hits for an empty literal across `packages/**` and `ui/**` tests). The BREAKING banner therefore addresses external API callers only, which is what the changeset's "Who sees it" says.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/27484-blank-search-fields-refused.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest`; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, identical to the PR body's two lines; `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, a category the gate lists (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` L147); `Check Changeset` is `success` on the head.
- The level matches what the diff publishes: the packages whose runtime moves are exactly those two (objectql changes are test-only; `packages/spec` is untouched). AGENTS.md's rule — a non-protocol narrowing ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition — is met. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: a query value, not a key a metadata author writes.
- The BREAKING body carries Before / Now / Unchanged / Who sees it / Remedy; the migration is the remedy sentence (send a field name or omit the parameter) — the only one there is.
- Two prose gaps against the diff: the no-`search` case (① 2) is absent from Before/Now, and the body says nothing about the published declaration still admitting the refused value nor about the `POST` door's `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `VALIDATION_ERROR` split with the sibling (① 6). Both are should-fix on the prose, not on the level.

### ③ Boundary flags

- os-dev-report 6499580381, `open_questions[0]` (the refusal locus, A / B / C): answered by ruling 6500648325, **A**. The diff implements A exactly — one refusal site at the protocol door, every spelling, both pins flipped and named with the ruling id in the test comments and the PR body. Closed.
- os-dev-report 6503706236, `open_questions: []`. `deviations[0]` (PR body header and footer carry the card thread's session, not the seat's; the seat said it would rewrite the header before landing): the body on the head still opens with the harness attribution and "Requested by Sales · project thread" and closes with `session_01L6bhgTgHg75Rd5XFiwbUZh` — pending on the seat, a housekeeping item, not a design flag. `deviations[1]` (worktree kept): housekeeping; remove after landing.
- `out_of_scope_findings[0]` in both reports (json export writes its opening bracket before the first `findData`, so any `findData` refusal there — this one and the existing `searchFields=nope` one — lands as a truncated stream instead of a 400; csv and xlsx answer the envelope): "carrier: none · noted, not filed". Prime Directive #10 names a reproducible defect as an issue and never buries one in acceptance notes; the PR's Acceptance notes are not a carrier. Escalated — should-fix S3: file the card.
- Raised by this review, for triage, as one follow-up card: (i) does `$searchFields` / `searchFields` / `search.fields` follow `select` into a declared accept set (the #26909 shape, so the `POST` door answers the schema door's code for both siblings and the published JSON Schema stops admitting what the door refuses); (ii) does the engine follow (the #27008 shape) or stay tolerant as ruled? The two are one question because the canonical `searchFields` declaration is shared by the engine and the door — tightening it while the engine stays tolerant recreates the declared-admits / engine-refuses-nothing shape #27008 closed. Not a rider on this PR.
- Ruling 6500648325 "flip two pins deliberately": done as ruled; the junction leg still proves no `lib_loan` read and the two other legs still pin the engine's junction refusal.
- The PR body's hot-file note (#27535, `merge-tree` clean) is outside this review's inputs and is not judged here.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts` — holds.** Shape first (string split / trim / filter; array with a non-string member → `INVALID_FIELD`; any other type → `INVALID_FIELD`), then the new empty-list refusal, then the field-map tiering — the #4196 order the function names. Tried to break it: `searchFields: null` is `!= null`-false at the call site, so absent stays absent; `searchFields: [' ']` keeps one blank member in the array arm and is refused downstream as an unknown field (a blank name is never one), the same split `projectionFieldsValue`'s array arm makes — consistent, not a finding; object-form `fields: ''` reaches the gate through the `search.fields != null` call site. The message quotes the raw wire value through `quotedQueryValue` (bounded at 64 chars), since the gate runs ahead of the spec's parse-time lowering (`data-engine.zod.ts` L1117 belongs to the engine's side). The thrown runtime string carries no tracker number; the `[#27484]` tag is in a code comment, where the repo allows it.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` — holds.** One word (`export`) and a docblock sentence; the call sites (L13192–L13199) do not move; the hot-file region claim is true of the diff.
- **`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` — holds.** The route's other parameters already judge a blank value per parameter (`limit=` refused via `emptyIsAbsent: false` #20062; `fields=`, `search=`, `filter=`, `orderby=` read as absent), so there is no single door rule this breaks; `searchFields` now answers as it does on the list door because the refusal is `findData`'s, not the route's. The one asymmetry left — `fields=` blank is read as schema columns on export while `$select=` blank is refused on the list — predates this PR and is out of its scope. Declared: the changeset's Before names the export drop; the docs table names `searchFields=`.
- **`packages/objectql/src/engine-search-empty-set.test.ts` — holds.** The flipped leg asserts `VALIDATION_ERROR` / `status 400` / `param 'searchFields'` and keeps the read-count assertion (no `lib_loan` read on either refusal); the control object and the blank term are still pinned. What the file can no longer prove — that a blank override over the junction reaches the engine's own refusal — is unreachable by construction under option A.
- **`packages/objectql/src/query-expression-conformance.test.ts` — holds.** Seven spellings each asserting `status` / `code` / `param`, plus the absent-override control. Note (no action owed): no case pins the quoted value (`got ""` vs `got []`); one `toThrow` on the message would.
- **`packages/rest/src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts` — holds.** Real `RestServer` over `findData`, ObjectQL and sqlite; the four GET spellings, two POST slots and two export spellings each assert status, code and the named spelling, with zero driver reads of the object; the controls cover all three doors in both directions (named narrows, absent scans). Same harness shape as the sibling file.
- **Prose faces.** `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` L157 row: matches the door. `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` L551–L556: matches, and its "Internal callers reaching `engine.find()` directly are unaffected" is true (① 5). The changeset: see ② and S1 / S2.

**Findings.** Must-fix: none. Should-fix: **S1** — changeset Before/Now and PR body: state that an empty `searchFields` is refused with or without a `search` term on the list and query doors (export alone ignores it without `search`). **S2** — changeset "Unchanged" or Acceptance notes: state that `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields`, `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.searchFields` and `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` still admit the refused value, and that on `POST /data/:object/query` the sibling `select: []` answers `VALIDATION_FAILED` while `searchFields: []` answers `VALIDATION_ERROR`; file the follow-up card named in ③ for the declaration (and the engine question). **S3** — file the json-export truncated-stream defect as a card; an acceptance note is not a carrier.

Inputs: that diff, the PR body on this head, the check-runs on this head, and the two cards the body cites.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set or public-surface change in the delta: a changeset body edit only. Judgments 1–8 of `6504124784` hold on this head as written.
- The two new sentences are true of the tree I read: (a) "on the list and query doors this holds with or without a `search` term" — the gate is called whether or not a term rode along (`protocol.ts` L13184–L13199), the list door hands `req.query` straight to `findData` (`crud-routes.ts` L157–L163), the export route forwards `searchFields` only beside `search` (`data-action-routes.ts` L1355); (b) the four declarations named — `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields` (`data-engine.zod.ts` L962), `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.searchFields` (L189), `QuerySchema.searchFields` (`query.zod.ts` L549), `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` (L452) — do admit `''` and `[]`, and the `POST /data/:object/query` split (`select: []` → body schema's `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts` L166–L175; `searchFields: []` → the gate's `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts` L369–L378) is what the two door tests pin.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; the two declaration lines are identical to the PR body's. The first `Check Changeset` run on this head concluded `success`; a second run of the same name is still in progress.
- S1 closed: the "Now" bullet names the no-`search` case on the list and query doors and keeps the export exception in "Unchanged". The PR body's "What changes" (L23) says the same, in the same words as the tree.
- S2 closed as far as this PR can close it: a new "Not yet narrowed" bullet names the four declarations, the `POST` door split, and the carrier #27683; the PR body's Acceptance notes (L71) match it and add the engine question. #27683 exists, is open, and its body names the same four declarations and the ruling it needs — the follow-up is a card, not a rider, as ③ of `6504124784` asked.
- S3 closed: Acceptance notes L70 now reads "filed as #27682"; #27682 exists, is open, and describes the json-export truncated-stream defect with a reproduction, crediting the dev's reports and the review.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Nothing new. Both escalations of `6504124784` now have carriers (#27682, #27683).
